purpose: Broad-market point-in-time test of a systematic proxy for the user's Japanese equity fundamental strategy

holdout.reason: Unused one-year window relative to prior v1-v4 tests; rules fixed before downloading security-level holdout files in this run

data.equities: JPX Tokyo Stock Exchange Prediction dataset mirror (stock_prices.csv, financials.csv, stock_list.csv)
data.benchmark: 1306.T adjusted-close total-return proxy from Yahoo chart API; TOPIX price-index proxy from cross-sectional eligible-universe value-weighted return also shown
limitations: The public mirror is exchange-origin competition data but is not an official JPX download endpoint
The competition universe may contain survivor-selection relative to the 2021 universe definition
Buyback, mid-term-plan narrative and full cash-flow disclosures are unavailable in the tabular financial dataset; the test is a systematic proxy, not a literal replay of every qualitative prompt item

universe.base: All securities present in the JPX competition price file and identified as domestic common equities in the stock-list file where available
dynamic_eligibility_each_month: At least 120 prior valid trading-day closes
At least 15 valid trading days in the prior 20 trading days
Prior-20-day average traded value >= JPY 300 million
Latest financial disclosure available by the monthly cutoff
Positive latest operating profit and net income
Not under supervision flag on cutoff

rebalance.signal_cutoff: Last trading day of each month at close
rebalance.weighting: Equal weight among active selected names; unused capacity remains cash

fundamental_score.pass: Score >= 4, positive operating profit and profit, and no -4 event

price_confirmation.lookback: 42 trading days ending at signal cutoff
price_confirmation.excess_return: > 0 versus 1306.T total-return proxy over the same trading dates

portfolio.entry: Selected at cutoff and bought next trading-day open
portfolio.duplicate_signal: Do not open a second lot while already held
portfolio.exit: First trading-day open on or after 126 trading days from entry, or earlier on a monthly -4 forecast-cut signal
portfolio.dividends: Use ExpectedDividend cash field only when non-null on a held security date; report price-only sensitivity separately
portfolio.corporate_actions: Use cumulative AdjustmentFactor to create continuous adjusted prices

metrics: Sharpe ratio with zero risk-free rate
optimization_prohibition: No threshold, holding period, position count, weight, date, or inclusion rule may be changed after results are computed. No sensitivity result may replace the registered primary result.
